title: apps/api router.test.ts 'actual producer -> Python first/reclaim/fences -> real production Mongo binding -> ...' fails in the full apps/api suite on untouched main (and on this lane) but passes alone on both
evidence: main 0a1bec47 full run: 'node --test --import tsx src/**/*.test.ts' with D2_FIXTURE_PYTHON=main .venv python -> fail 2 (this test + usage 'a hanging write ... timeout'); lane 936113b6 full run: fail 1 (this test). Error: 'upload queue operation timeout' raised as async activity after the test ended (5.2-5.6 s). router.test.ts alone: 3/3 pass on main and on lane, twice each, with and without D2_FIXTURE_PYTHON. So the test is order/load dependent, not caused by the lane.
fix_direction: Give the Python-producer fixture a timeout that does not depend on suite load, or run the file isolated; investigate whether an earlier test leaves the fixture queue/Mongo binding contended.
